tool.boot_blame.title: Boot Time Blame
tool.boot_blame.description: Read-only list of per-unit boot timing parsed from `systemd-analyze blame`. Returns up to 50 entries with raw time string and parsed seconds.
tool.boot_critical_chain.title: Critical Startup Chain
tool.boot_critical_chain.description: Read-only critical startup dependency chain from `systemd-analyze critical-chain [unit]`. Each line exposes unit, depth, activation (@) and elapsed (+) marks.
tool.last_boot_log.title: Last Boot Journal
tool.last_boot_log.description: Read-only latest journal entries from previous boot (journalctl -b -1). Optional priority filter (0..7 or emerg..debug).
tool.coredumps_list.title: Kernel Coredump List
tool.coredumps_list.description: Read-only coredump inventory from `coredumpctl list --json=short`. Includes time, pid, uid/gid, signal, coredump file state (present / inaccessible), executable path, and size in bytes. Inaccessible entries keep a note but null size.
tool.coredump_info.title: Kernel Coredump Detail
tool.coredump_info.description: Read-only per-coredump detail from `coredumpctl info <pid>`. Fields map (parsed Key: Value pairs) plus raw output (stack trace included). Raw output is truncated at 64KiB.
